appraisal_events.evidence: Albertine rattles off tram, tacot, golf, bals du Casino, courses de la Sogne with confident nasal ease; the narrator says he sensed 'sa maîtrise dans un mode de désignations' and feared she would notice and despise his 'infériorité.'
appraisal_events.explanation: The passage locally elevates Albertine by staging her fluent command of the petite bande's idiom and sporting world, against which the narrator measures himself as intimidated and lesser.

status_effects.explanation: Her confident, rapid-fire command of slang and activities gives her the upper hand in the exchange on the digue.
He is intimidated by her verbal ease and fears she will register and scorn his comparative unfamiliarity with the idiom.
